page.content:
Mahmoud al-Asran is an Assamite of the Vizier Caste who worked together with the Setite Teotukapis in Damascus. The Setite elders wanted to ally with the Assamites to purge the Children of Judas from the region.

page.overview:
What is Mahmoud al-Asran?

Mahmoud al-Asran is an Assamite of the Vizier Caste who worked together with the Setite Teotukapis in Damascus. The Setite elders wanted to ally with the Assamites to purge the Children of Judas from the region.
